questions.prompt: Which civilization created the Nazca Lines?
questions.fact: The lines are so large that most were only recognised once aircraft began flying over the desert in the 20th century.

questions.prompt: What process do plants use to convert light into chemical energy?
questions.fact: Nearly all of a tree's mass comes from carbon pulled out of the air, not from the soil it is standing in.

questions.prompt: Which country hosts the Wimbledon tennis championships?
questions.fact: It is the only Grand Slam still played on grass, and the only one with a strict all-white clothing rule.

questions.prompt: In 'The Wizard of Oz', what color are Dorothy's slippers in the film?
questions.fact: In the book the slippers are silver. They were changed to show off Technicolor.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Austria?
questions.fact: Its drinking water arrives by gravity from Alpine springs, through pipelines built in the 19th century.

questions.prompt: Which dystopian novel introduced the phrase 'Big Brother is watching you'?
questions.fact: Orwell wrote it in 1948 and reversed the final two digits to get the title.

questions.prompt: What is the binary representation of the decimal number 4?
questions.fact: Binary counts in powers of two: this means one four, no twos and no ones.
